title: 日本ダービーの後に・2つ目の冠

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon lives up to her fans' expectations and takes the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower approaches us unsteadily, muttering in despair that she wasn't able to catch up with Mihono Bourbon, and falls unconscious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are only two outcomes to a race—victory or defeat. Despite this, Rice Shower is focused on catching up, which confuses Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I reassure her that she'll understand someday. In the meantime, we establish the final Classic Triple Crown race, the Kikuka Sho, as our next goal.
